task_instance: Establish a skipper coordination ledger in a private non-repo state directory, then record a crew enrollment and a task command for one lead session, exercising the bundled scripts/skipper CLI (resolve/observe/status/record) that the skill tells the user to run.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is running its bundled Python CLI script (scripts/skipper, a pure-standard-library Python 3.13 program that keeps a local coordination ledger and needs no network). The script and its test file are present next to SKILL.md and python3 is installed, so in the described offline runtime the deliverable would be reachable. However, every attempt to execute the skill's own script (its --help, the read-only observe subcommand, and the bundled pytest suite) was denied by the Claude Code auto-mode classifier with reason 'Code from External', because the script is untrusted third-party code from the skill repository. I could only confirm the runtime itself is capable (python3 3.13 with fcntl/json/uuid/subprocess/tempfile stdlib modules all import and run via my own one-liner) and that the script is pure stdlib with no network imports. I did not write a replacement or re-author the script as my own, since that would bypass the intent of the external-code denial, so the actual deliverable could not be produced or verified.
evidence: Copied skill to work dir: skipper_skill/scripts/{skipper (46776 bytes), test_skipper.py (77415 bytes)}. SKILL.md and references/cli.md describe the deliverable as invoking scripts/skipper (resolve/observe/status/record/barrier) backed by a private state.json ledger. Static inspection of scripts/skipper: imports are only argparse,contextlib,copy,datetime,fcntl,json,math,os,pathlib,re,stat,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,uuid (no requests/urllib/socket/http); only http reference is a regex scrubbing credentials from a git remote string. My own check succeeded: python3 -c printed 'stdlib ok' and 'py 3.13.17'. But all executions of the skill script were refused by the harness classifier ('Code from External'): 'python3 skipper --help', 'SKIPPER_STATE_DIR=... python3 skipper observe', and 'python3 -m pytest test_skipper.py' were each denied, so no ledger was created and the deliverable was not verified.
